facts.note: States that when the temple bell struck nine, his watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and that the uncle made a scene about it at dinner.
States he went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
States a thump above in the atelier at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted, in that order.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at a quarter past ten by his watch, and came quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten. He did not see who, and the door was shut.
Girard came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.

added.quote: He was up there with his bench and his four years of work
added.why: Places the uncle in the atelier at the time of the thump and repeater (about 10:18), which the fact sheet does not state. It gives the uncle a whereabouts at a moment the sheet does not cover.
